info.title: API-DocTest-List Auto Insurance Quotes Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Auto Insurance Quote Status API enables users to retrieve the current status of their auto insurance quotes. This endpoint allows consumers to track the progress of their quotes throughout the evaluation process, ensuring timely and informed decision-making. Typical use cases include agents checking the status for clients or policyholders verifying their quotes. By offering real-time status updates, this API enhances customer engagement and satisfaction.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of quotes.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the status of existing quotes in the system. You can use this to monitor the progress and state of quotes that have been submitted for processing.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of quotes. It should contain the necessary parameters to specify which quotes the status pertains to.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of quotes.
